# Two easy days in Porto

## Day 1

Start late. The Ribeira riverside is busiest after eleven, so have coffee near Batalha first and walk down the steep lanes toward the river while your legs are fresh. If the tram line 1 is running, ride it out to Foz in the afternoon and walk back along the water; if it is not, the 500 bus covers the same stretch.

## Day 2

Cross the Dom Luis I bridge on the upper deck in the morning, when the light is behind you, and spend the middle of the day in the Gaia port lodges. If rain sets in, the lodges are your shelter; the cable car closes in high wind, so take the lower bridge back instead.
